mara@harborlight: ~ — glass click to focus · Tab completes · Ctrl+R searches
 

Quick keys

  • Tab complete command / path
  • ↑ ↓ history
  • Ctrl+R reverse search
  • Ctrl+A/E line start / end
  • Ctrl+U/K kill before / after
  • Ctrl+W delete word
  • Ctrl+L clear screen

Try these

  • tour
  • find . -name "*.md" | wc -l
  • grep WARN logs/tidewatch.log
  • find . -name "*.toml"
  • cat notes/todo.md | tail -3
  • fortune | cowsay
  • neofetch
  • echo "hi $USER" > hi.txt && cat hi.txt

Everything is in-memory and saved to localStorage. Use Reset FS to start over.
